title: A Short Walk after a Cold
story: Marco had stayed in bed for three days with a bad cold. The doctor said a short walk was fine if he went slowly. He put on a coat and soft shoes and stepped outside with his sister. They walked only as far as the park gate. Marco felt warm, so they stopped and drank water. He did not run, and he did not take the long path. On the way back he breathed easily and talked a little. At home he rested on the sofa and ate soup. His sister wrote the time and the distance in a notebook. The next day he walked to the gate and then around the small pond. He still stopped for water and came home before he felt tired. Marco told the doctor that the plan was working. He agreed to wait another week before he joined his team.
